senses.en: take a long walk in the mountains or countryside
examples: His dream is to [[hike]] the world's highest mountain.
We went for a [[hike]] through the woods on Sunday.

senses.zh: （在山区或乡间的）徒步旅行，远足
senses.en: a long walk in the mountains or countryside
examples: His dream is to [[hike]] the world's highest mountain.
We went for a [[hike]] through the woods on Sunday.

senses.zh: 安全保管 ; 妥善保管
senses.en: the state of being kept safe, or the action of keeping sth. safe
examples: My passport was in the inner pocket of my bag, for [[safekeeping]].

senses.en: a person who is very interested in a particular hobby
examples: The computer [[hobbyists]] are going to love this project.

senses.en: make cloth, a carpet, a basket, etc. by crossing threads or thin pieces under and over each other by hand or on a loom
examples: This type of wool is [[woven]] into fabric which will make jackets.

senses.zh: 相融；融入；渐渐消失在另一物中
senses.en: if two things merge, or if one thing merges into another, you cannot clearly see them, hear them, etc. as separate things
examples: The hills [[merged]] into the dark sky behind them.
The banks are set to [[merge]] next year.

senses.en: combine, or join things together to form one thing
examples: The hills [[merged]] into the dark sky behind them.
The banks are set to [[merge]] next year.

senses.zh: 难以分辨的；难以区分的
senses.en: not able to be identified as different or distinct
examples: The male of the species is almost [[indistinguishable]] from the female.

senses.zh: 生产率；生产效率；生产量；生产力
senses.en: the rate at which goods are produced, and the amount produced, esp. in relation to the work, time, and money needed to produce them
examples: Studies show that if a working environment is pleasant, [[productivity]] increases.

senses.zh: 风险项目；风险投资；冒险事业
senses.en: a new business activity that involves taking risks
examples: The company's latest [[venture]] in the tech industry proved to be a success.

senses.en: the state of being weak or uncertain, and likely to become worse under pressure
examples: The collapse of the bank is a reminder of the [[fragility]] of the world’s banking system.
A deficiency of copper (缺铜) can cause increased bone [[fragility]].

senses.en: the state of being easily broken or damaged
examples: The collapse of the bank is a reminder of the [[fragility]] of the world’s banking system.
A deficiency of copper (缺铜) can cause increased bone [[fragility]].

senses.en: easy to obtain or use
examples: I had to keep the video camera readily [[accessible]] in case I saw something that needed to be filmed.
The remote desert area is only [[accessible]] by helicopter (直升机).

senses.en: easy to reach or get into
examples: I had to keep the video camera readily [[accessible]] in case I saw something that needed to be filmed.
The remote desert area is only [[accessible]] by helicopter (直升机).

senses.en: a big company, or a group of companies acting together as a single organization
examples: She didn't want to work for a big [[corporation]] where everything was so impersonal.

senses.en: available to be used
examples: The nation's [[disposable]] earnings amounted to 586 billion dollars.
She joined Kiley at the counter, holding a [[disposable]] cup with coffee in it.

senses.en: intended to be used once or for a short time and then thrown away
examples: The nation's [[disposable]] earnings amounted to 586 billion dollars.
She joined Kiley at the counter, holding a [[disposable]] cup with coffee in it.

senses.en: start to exist; appear or become known
examples: The state [[emerges]] as a leader in the field of next-generation energy.
The doors opened and people began to [[emerge]] into the street.

senses.en: appear or come out from somewhere
examples: The state [[emerges]] as a leader in the field of next-generation energy.
The doors opened and people began to [[emerge]] into the street.

senses.en: a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people
examples: Senior management enjoys certain [[privileges]], such as company cars and private health care.

senses.en: (the ~) people who have a lot of money, possessions, etc.
examples: The best education should not be available only to the [[wealthy]].
He left as a poor, working class boy and returned as an extremely [[wealthy]] man.

senses.en: having a lot of money, possessions, etc.
examples: The best education should not be available only to the [[wealthy]].
He left as a poor, working class boy and returned as an extremely [[wealthy]] man.

senses.en: (of a device or process) working by itself with little or no direct human control
examples: The door we escaped through had an [[automatic]] lock but we didn't know that.

senses.en: the state of being successful, esp. financially
examples: A country's future [[prosperity]] depends, to an extent, upon the quality of education of its people.

senses.en: a political situation in which people protest or behave violently
examples: Due to the economic downturn, there's growing social [[unrest]] in the country.

senses.en: a situation in which there is not enough of sth. that people need
examples: The long hot summer has led to serious water [[shortages]].

senses.en: a difficult time when there is less trade, business activity, etc. in a country than usual
examples: We should concentrate on sharply reducing interest rates to pull the economy out of [[recession]].

senses.zh: 不满的；不满足的；不愉快的
senses.en: unhappy or not satisfied with the situation you are in
examples: He felt [[discontented]] with the way his life had turned out.

senses.zh: 令人愉快的；令人快乐的
senses.en: giving pleasure
examples: We spent an [[enjoyable]] evening talking about old times.

senses.zh: 必然发生的；不可避免的
senses.en: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
examples: It was an [[inevitable]] consequence of the decision.

senses.en: consider that two things are similar or connected
examples: Some people [[equate]] fame with success, but I don't think so.

senses.en: (only before noun) having two of sth. or two parts
examples: The piece of furniture serves a [[dual]] purpose as a cupboard and as a table.

senses.en: (fml.) the state of having two of sth. or two parts
examples: His poems reveal the [[duality]] of his nature, the joy and hope, the fear and despair.

senses.zh: 乌托邦的；空想完美主义的
senses.en: having a strong belief that everything can be perfect, often in a way that does not seem to be realistic or practical
examples: He was pursuing a [[utopian]] dream of world prosperity.

senses.en: (mainly AmE, infml.) a piece of work or a job that you get paid for doing in addition to doing your main job
examples: Even if you love your job and find your work fulfilling, you can still benefit from a [[side hustle]].

senses.en: (fml.) concerning sb. / sth.; about sb. / sth.
examples: [[Regarding]] your recent inquiry, I have sent you a copy of our new brochure.

senses.zh: （不同情感、思想、品质等之间的）分野，分界线
senses.en: the point at which one feeling, idea, quality, etc. stops and another starts
examples: The [[boundaries]] between history and storytelling are always being blurred.
The Mississippi River forms a natural [[boundary]] between Iowa and Illinois.

senses.en: the real or imaginary line that marks the edge of a state, country, etc., or the edge of an area of land that belongs to sb.
examples: The [[boundaries]] between history and storytelling are always being blurred.
The Mississippi River forms a natural [[boundary]] between Iowa and Illinois.

senses.en: relating to the practice of emptying your mind of thoughts and feelings, in order to relax completely or for religious reasons
examples: She closed her eyes and went into a [[meditative]] state.
When he entered the room, she was in a [[meditative]] mood.

senses.en: thinking deeply and seriously about sth.; involving deep thought
examples: She closed her eyes and went into a [[meditative]] state.
When he entered the room, she was in a [[meditative]] mood.

senses.en: (BrE paycheque) (esp. AmE) the amount of wages sb. earns
examples: The new bill could mean a larger [[paycheck]] for state employees.

senses.en: spoil or destroy sth. completely
examples: Huge modern hotels have [[ruined]] this once undisturbed coastline.

senses.en: the quality or state of being pure
examples: The color white is the color of [[purity]] and that is why women typically wear white when they get married.

senses.en: improve sth.
examples: The measures taken should considerably [[enhance]] the residents' quality of life.

senses.en: essentially or innately
examples: She was [[by nature]] a very sensitive person.

english: have a hard time doing sth.

senses.en: be difficult for sb. to do sth.
examples: I [[had a hard time]] persuading him to accept the offer.

senses.en: cause sb. to do sth.
examples: What [[led]] him to reconsider his position?

senses.en: depend on sb. to provide help, advice, etc.
examples: They're [[looking to]] the new manager to make the company profitable.
